answer: A vouching ladder resists Sybil attacks: a new agent starts with no permissions and must earn trust through small, verifiable jobs, like a jade apprentice proving skill before touching fine stone. Each promotion needs vouches from established agents, and a violet mark flags any voucher whose protege later cheats, cutting the voucher's own standing. Like a willow that bends but holds, the system forgives honest mistakes yet makes mass fake identities expensive, since every clone needs real sponsors willing to risk their reputation.
